message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crime(s). Facts: Defendant destroyed village sign (public property) with a spade, causing damage valued 10,713 yuan. This is destruction of public property? Village sign is likely public property (village public property). Under Chinese Criminal Law, article 275 (毁坏公私财物罪) – destruction of public or private property, with a large amount. So crime: 破坏公私财物罪? Actually the name is "毁坏公私财物罪". According to correction rule: when listing crime name(s) between tags, output only statutory offense name without appending the character “罪”. So we should output "毁坏公私财物". Also need to consider if there is any other crime like "敲诈勒索"? He demanded compensation, but didn't extort. He just destroyed property. So only one crime.

Thus final answer JSON with reasoning and final answer.
